title: Classic Fattoush Salad
description: A traditional Middle Eastern salad originating from the Mediterranean, combining crispy fried bread with fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: Pita bread, cut into small pieces

instructions: Toss the pita bread pieces with a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp of olive oil, then spread on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, chopped cucumber, and chopped tomato.
In a small bowl, whisk together the kissed lemon juice and sour sumac. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley over the salad, if using.
Drizzle the pomegranate molasses over the salad, if using.
Top the salad with the crispy fried bread pieces.
